messages:
li: Quick question — thinking through the opt-in rollforward UX and how it should tie to telemetry and trace sampling. Do we want higher trace sampling for opt-in traffic while the rollforward is in canary? Also how should console surface gating signals (errors, p95 latency, quota delta)?

jon: I think yes to higher sampling initially. Proposal: 10% traces for first 60m of canary, then down to 1% if stable. Gate rules: rollback if
- compat_error_rate (opt-in cohort) > 0.5% for 5m OR
- p95 latency increase > 20% relative to baseline for 5m.

maya: agree re sampling. also flag: routing to v2 changes token accounting slightly (tokenization model tweak). We need a per-tenant projected cost delta in console and an opt-in confirmation modal.

sam: +1. For telemetry queries we should add explicit cohort labels so slices are unambiguous. e.g. traces where tag rollforward_optin=true. Also recommend we emit metric: rollforward_probe_success{tenant} = bool for quick dashboards.

kevin: Important: fallback semantics — if v2 backend reports capacity error (503/overloaded) we should failover to v1 for that tenant for N requests with sticky backoff. But that means some traffic will be split and metrics must reflect which backend answered. Could we add header negotiation snippet to client SDKs?

li: here's a small example header we could use for SDKs / console override:
```
# opt-in header example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n     -H "X-Redwood-Client-Version: 2;opt-in=true" \n     https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```
If header present route to v2 opt-in path. If absent unchanged.

prod-ux: For console UX: show three items on the opt-in page — (1) expected cost delta (est. tokens/day) with a small tooltip explaining token calc, (2) health gates with tooltips (error rate threshold, p95 threshold, rollout duration), (3) a quick revert button visible during the canary window. Also show the % of requests that flowed to v2 in last 10m.

jon: I'll add the gating checks to the rolling-deploy job. We should add PromQL-ish probes so ops can preview:
- compat_error_rate = sum(rate(http_errors_total{route="v2-optin",job="gateway"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="v2-optin",job="gateway"}[5m]))
- p95_latency_ratio = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="v2-optin"}[5m])) by (le)) / baseline_p95

maya: A few operational notes:
- Ensure per-tenant quota mapping is visible. If v2 charges differently we need a console warning and an opt-in checkbox.
- For users on Dedicated we should surface that Private customers can't opt-in via console; needs a support flow.

ops-bot: canary-runner: started canary rollout for tenant: "acme-corp" -> route: v2-optin (10% traffic) at 1742203600 :rocket:

kevin: Good to know. Remember to tag traces with rollforward_optin=true and backend=v2 so we can slice. Also emit event to audit-log for each tenant opt-in action.

sam: sampling cadence: also recommend we temporarily bump logging level for v2 edges during the canary window (for 15m) to capture unexpected payloads. Then auto-downgrade logs to normal.

li: action items I see: 
- jon: implement gating probes + automated rollback thresholds in rolling-deploy job (10% sampling -> 1% baseline)
- sam: ensure trace tag + temp log bump control exists
- maya: console copy + cost delta UI + Dedicated opt-out note
- kevin: SDK header docs + audit-log event for opt-in
- prod-ux: design revert button + show % routed metric

li: thanks all — can we aim to have the console copy + probe PRs by EOD Friday so we can schedule the canary next week? :eyes:
